Both the batsmen were troubled regularly by the English pacers but they kept their wickets intact and ensured Pakistan finished the day on top. England had an opportunity to break the stand but Stokes messed it up by dropping a catch of Sohail at the fag end of the day.

An excellent start to the Test series for Pakistan. The visitors dominated the proceedings for a major part of the day and the final session was no different. They snared the remaining five England wickets quite cheaply and ensured they restricted the home team to a small total. Mohammad Abbas and Hasan Ali were the destroyers-in-chief. Both picked four wickets apiece, while the rest of the pacers supported them really well.
Shortish delivery and it is well-directed as well, trying to induce a false stroke from Ali. However, he stays composed and keeps it out. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Short of a length, angling in. Ali initially wants to play it across but at the last moment, he bails out. Gets hit around the thigh pad.
Ali lets the wide delivery go. He has been cautious about these kind of deliveries and leaves it nicely as he has been doing all through this evening.
Leg slip comes into position. England on the attack.
On a good length and outside the off stump from Stokes. Ali tries to guide the ball through the gap between gully and the  slip cordon but finds the fielder.
Ali leaves it alone for the keeper.
Short and into the body of Ali. He plays it down with soft hands.
Ben Stokes will bowl the last over of the day. He dropped a catch a few moments back. Can he provide a breakthrough for his side?
FOUR! Good shot! A bit short this time, spinning away. Sohail rocks back and cuts it through covers. He has hit that well and gets the desired result. A decent start for Bess though.
Tossed up generously outside off, driven hard towards covers where the fielder makes a good stop.
Fuller in length outside off, played with an open bat face towards the same region.
Bess has found a good rhythm. Bowls a quicker one and gets it to turn away, cut towards backward point.
Gives this one more air, Sohail prods forward in defense.
Good start from the debutant! Bowls this on a flat trajectory around off, coming in with the arm. Sohail is a bit late but does well to block it.
The debutant, Dominic Bess, to roll his arm over now. He is a promising off spinner. Let's see how he fares at the biggest stage.
Brilliant fielding! Saved a certain boundary there. Overpitched outside off, Ali drills it towards covers where Broad dives to his left to make a great stop.
Fuller length ball, Ali taps it past the point fielder and comes back for a couple.
Back of a length delivery, defended solidly off the back foot.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

That is nasty! Shortish delivery, climbing on Ali. He gets into an uncomfortable position as he tries to work it away but is hit on the bottom hand. Shakes his hand in pain and takes some time to gather himself. Seems to be alright.
Short leg is in again.
Short of a length ball around leg stump, tucked past square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, dealt from the back foot nicely.
In the air... but safe! Stokes hits the deck hard and angles it on middle and leg. Ali hops and is early into his clip shot. Ends up getting an edge which falls short of the bowler.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Dug in short, Ali ducks underneath it.
Length ball this time, Azhar covers the line and pushes it to covers.
Fullish delivery, angling in, Ali clips it towards square leg.

Put down! Stokes has spilled an opportunity, what otherwise would have been an easy catch for the second slip. Wood squared up the batsman, with a nice outswinger, from around the wicket. Sohail gets a leading edge and the ball is going straight into the hands of Dawid Malan, standing at second slip but Stokes dives to his right and goes at it with one hand and drops it. How costly will that prove?

Angled in, on a goodish length and crashes on to the back foot of Sohail. He tries to defend it from the crease but misses the ball. Appeal from the bowler and the fielders but the umpire doesn't agree. The replay also suggests that the ball is going over the stumps.
Touch short, in the corridor of uncertainty for the batsman. Ali gets behind it nicely and defends it with hard hands towards the short cover fielder.
Joe Root is coming under the lid at short leg. Expect some short stuff from Wood.
Touch fuller and on to his pads and Sohail flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Same length, just outside the off stump and Sohail puts down his front foot and punches the ball towards mid on.
Defends the good length delivery nicely as the ball rolls to the gully fielder.
In the avenue of apprehension, no real movement on this occasion. The opener lets it through.

FOUR! Well played! Full length ball outside off, Ali crouches a bit and squirts it away past the slip region to find the third man fence. it is important for the opener to score runs as well. Going into a shell can prove to be fatal at times.
This one is well outside off, Ali is in no mood to go for any expansive strokes and leaves it alone.
Stokes runs in hard and bowls an effort ball. Ali makes use of the depth of the crease to stonewall it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Straying on the hips, tucked through square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, Azhar sits under the bumper.
Peach! Angling in initially and then shaping away late to induce a false stroke from Ali and he gets foxed. His teammates clap for Wood. He is looking in good rhythm.
Nervy! Wood goes wider of the crease and angles this in substantially on a fullish length. Hits Ali's bat hard and his bottom hand comes off in the process. Manages to block it somehow.
In the corridor of uncertainty, holding its line. Azhar remains circumspect in his approach.
Hangs back to the good length ball and punches it to the off side.
Nicely bowled! Shortish delivery around off, rising on Ali. He gets into an awkward position and fends it off towards point.
Flicks the ball off his pads towards square leg and keeps the strike for the next over.
Gets the outside half of the bat, the ball rolls towards the extra cover region and they scamper across for a single.
Squares him up a little with a full length delivery, on the leg stump, with the seam angling towards the first slip. Haris somehow blocks it.
Full, outside the off stump and the batsman tries to play it from his crease but misses. This has been the pattern from Sohail.
Full and on the leg stump, Sohail clips it towards deep mid-wicket for two.
Stokes goes around the wicket straightaway. He brings the first one in, on a goodish length and the ball thuds into Sohail's pads.
Ben Stokes is introduced into the attack. Can he strike before the end of today's play?
Similar delivery, Ali leaves it for the fifth time in a row. Another maiden for Wood.
Wood needs to make him play which he is not doing at the moment. Wide outside off and Azhar lets it go.
Once again this one is well outside off, Azhar watches it sail through to the keeper.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length this time but the line is way outside off. Ali plants his front foot across and allows it through.
Back of a length ball around off, Ali hops and defends it with a straight bat.
Once again, short of a length and too wide to interest Sohail.
Sohail is not going for the wider balls. Leaves it for the keeper.

Four Leg Byes! Over correction from the bowler this time. Bowls it back of a length, angling into the body but the angle takes it down the leg side. Clips Sohail's thigh pad and rushes to the fine leg boundary.
Beautifully done by Broad. Angles the ball in and takes it away from Sohail. This is full and just outside off stump and Sohail is lucky not to get anything on it.
Too wide for the batsman and he shoulders it to the keeper.
Broad goes around the wicket to get the ball into the batsman and make him play. Sohail plays the ball down with soft hands and guides it between the gully and slip fielder for two.
Jaffa! That one took off like a plane. Shortish delivery around off, climbing on Ali. He hops and fends at it but the ball just whizzes past his gloves. Good over from Wood.
In the channel outside off, Azhar doesn't fiddle with it.
This is testing stuff from Wood. Bowls a well-directed bouncer around off stump, Ali ducks under it.
Full delivery outside off, patted gently to the cover region.
Well bowled! Length delivery, angling in prodigiously. Ali is opened up in his stance and ends up getting a leading edge which falls short of the cover fielder.
Fuller length ball around off stump, kept out with a straight bat.
Rod Tucker is feeling cold and calls for the jacket. He puts it on and is ready to go again.
Full length ball in line of the stumps, Haris gets low and dead-bats it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

That'a a peach! David Lloyd on air discusses the importance of the presentation of the seam. If you can land the ball on the seam, it can always play tricks. This ball lands straight and then seams away after pitching. Sohail tries to block it but is beaten all ends up.
Broad steams in and bowls it on a stump-to-stump line, Sohail hangs back and blocks it.
Broad switches his angle to round the wicket.
Angling across Sohail who watches it sail through to the keeper.
Bowls a good length ball in that probing off stump channel, Haris has his stumps covered and makes an assured leave.
Five slips in place for Broad.
Wood is bowling in the good length area and on the stumps. Ali gets inside the line of the delivery and flicks it past the mid wicket fielder for two.
OHHH!!! Inside edge from Sohail rolls to the backward square fielder for a single. He is trying to drive the ball but gets it from the inside half of the bat.
Short of a length and into the stumps. Sohail defends it with a straight bat.
Deep square leg in place now.
Fullish length this time, outside the off stump and Ali comes forward and pushes the ball towards the cover fielder. Takes a single and changes strike.
Down the leg side. Some more pace from Wood. Ali is trying to get his bat on the ball but misses it.
Short of a length, some extra bounce and hurrying Ali. He get his bats on it and plays it with soft hands into the pitch.
Mark Wood comes into the attack. The umpires are having a look at the ball. Out comes the scissor and the leather which was coming out from the seam has been trimmed.
This one is again wide outside off, left on its way. Third maiden for Broad.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Good length ball around leg stump, coming in. Sohail tries to work it away but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. Broad is appealing and the batsman tries to sneak in a run. However, the fielder from covers attacks the ball and denies him.
Well-directed bouncer on middle, Haris sits under it in a jiffy.
Length ball, seaming away, Sohail doesn't fiddle with it.
Dug in short, Sohail ducks under it and evades it.
The artificial lights have taken full effect now. Good time to bowl with the clouds looming around.
Good length ball, shaping in, Azhar tries to clip it away with a closed bat face but gets a safe leading edge down the track.
Good shot! Full length ball, Haris drives it down the ground. Root from mid off and Broad from mid on hare after it. It is the skipper who reaches the ball first and cuts it off. Three runs taken.
Fuller in length, angling away from the southpaw. He plants his front foot across and makes a watchful leave.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length, angling in, tucked with a closed bat face towards square leg. A run taken.
Very full delivery, swerving in. Sohail jams it out and gets across to the other end.
No intent to play that one. Ali watches it go past him.
Down the leg side from Broad and Bairstow goes to his left to collect it.
Back of a length delivery, coming into the batsman and Ali leaves it.
Aimed at the stumps, Ali gets behind the delivery and defends it well.
Another full one from Broad. Ali lunges on the front foot to defend it but gets rapped on the pads. Huge appeal from the bowler and the fielders but they get no response from the umpire.

OHHH!!! Inside edge saves him. Ali is living dangerously in the middle. Coming to the ball, Broad bowls it full, around the off stump and almost had his man. Ali comes on the front foot and looks to play with bat and pad close to each other. However, he gets an inside edge on to his pads.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, Haris blocks it towards mid off.
Anderson switches his angle and comes from over the wicket. Bowls a good length ball on middle and off and gets it to seam away after landing. Sohail pokes at it and gets beaten.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Sohail gets a bit low and defends it calmly.
Similar delivery, Haris hangs back and keeps it out.
On a length in line of the stumps, tucked with a closed bat face to the leg side.

A big appeal for an LBW denied! This is on a goodish length, tailing into the batsman, who wants to clip it towards the square leg region but misses to get hit on the pads. Huge appeal form the bowler and the fielders but the umpire isn't convinced. Anderson has a discussion with his skipper and they have chosen against the review. The Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have missed the leg stump. Good call from the hosts.
Angling across Haris who remains circumspect in approach.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fullish delivery on leg stump, Sohail clips it through square leg and the ball whistles away to the fence.
On a length outside off, Sohail lets it go.
Haris Sohail comes out to bat.

OUT! Gone! Broad strikes! Good use of the DRS by England and Imam has to make his way back. Broad bowls a length ball around leg stump, the southpaw hangs back and tries to play it defensively to the leg side but misses to get pinged on the pads. The bowler is confident and so is the skipper, Joe Root. Their teammates also join in and the decision is challenged. The replays roll in. It has pitched in line and that puts the argument to bed. Hawk Eye shows three reds and Imam-ul-Haq is a dead duck. The on-field call has been reversed. Just the start the hosts needed.
Review time! The question is that if the ball has pitched in line of the stumps. Looks close to the naked eye. Is Imam-ul-Haq safe?
Short of length, on the leg side and clicks Ali's thigh pad. He was looking to shuffle across once again, to play it fine but misses the ball.
Full and on to his pads, Ali tries to flick it past the short mid wicket fielder but the connection wasn't there.
In the channel outside off, the southpaw doesn't flirt with it.
Beaten! Short of a length ball on middle and off, moves away after landing. Imam hops and tries to covers the line but the ball flies past his outside edge.
Slips this one down the leg side, Imam tries to glance it away but only manages to connect with thin air.
Sensible cricket! The right-hander taps it towards covers and takes off. Gets a good response from his partner and makes his crease comfortably.
Angling in this time, Azhar camps back and defends it stoutly.
Fuller in length outside off, Azhar plants his front foot across to let it go.

Flashes hard to the full ball. It is just outside the off stump, coming into the left-hander. He gets his cover drive out, only to get a thick outside edge. The ball rushes through the gully and slip region for a boundary.
Leaving on length and paying price for it. The ball hits Imam-ul-Haq on the chest guard. That looks a nasty blow but the Pakistan opener doesn't show any pain.
Short of a length, into Imam-ul-Haq's body, who gets behind to defend it straight.
Action repeat from the batsman. Broad is keeping this in a channel here. Keeping the batsman on his toes.
Wide of the of stump, tad short and Imam-ul-Haq lets it go.
Back of a length, angling across the batsman. Ali shuffles back and across and tries to defend it but the ball thuds into his thigh pad for a leg bye towards fine leg.

What a take from Bairstow! Down the leg side, Imam-ul-Haq tries to clip it away but the ball brushes his thigh pad and goes behind. The keeper dives to his right and takes it one-handed. An appeal from the Englishmen but the umpire is not interested. No bat involved there.
That flew off his bat! On the hips, tucked sweetly to deep backward square leg. A run taken.
FOUR! Classic! Fuller in length around off stump, Ali leans ahead and presents the full face of the bat. It has been timed nicely and the ball goes past mid off to reach the fence.
Brave leave from Ali! Length delivery well outside off, shaping in substantially. Ali knows where his off stump is and lets it go. That went over the stumps, good judgement.
Good length ball outside off, Azhar doesn't fiddle with it.
Pinpoint yorker around off, it is moving in the air as well. Ali does well to cover the line and jams it off the outer half of the bat towards the point region.
Leg side from Broad. Imam-ul-Haq is looking to get something on the ball but it's too far away. Bairstow scampers to his right to get the rising ball and does well to collect it cleanly.
Gets his bat out of the way. Similar length delivery, Stuart Broad's comfort zone.
Back of a length again and Imam-ul-Haq leaves it alone.
Copy paste stuff. Another leave of the same length.
Back of a length again and Imam-ul-Haq gets his bat up and lets it go.
Short of a length, angling away from the batsman. He flashes and misses the ball. Tentative start.
Stuart Broad to share the new ball from the other end.
Good length ball outside off, Ali leaves it alone. Good start from Anderson, a maiden.
That's a ripper! Unplayable. Good length ball, angling in initially and then shaping away after pitching. Ali has no option but to play at it and gets foxed.
In the channel outside off, fourth leave in a row.
Back of a length this time in the same zone, Ali is in no mood to flirt with it.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Ali remains circumspect in his approach and allows it to go through.
Good start from Anderson! Bowls a full length ball around off, a bit of nibble in the air as well. Azhar leans ahead and taps it to mid off.
